newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela panel approves CANTV publicity campaign.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela panel approves CANTV publicity campaign.

text.p: Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) said Friday it approved a publicity drive ahead of an offering of shares in telephone company CANTV.
However, any action on CANTV's sales prospectus will not come until next Wednesday, CNV said.
"It still has some details that need to be addressed," a CNV spokesperson told Reuters.
The prospectus for the government's 40 percent stake in the company must be approved before CANTV can place part of those shares on the Caracas bolsa.
According to a CANTV sales timetable obtained Friday by Reuters, screen trading is scheduled to begin on December 2.
